preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
The length of the array N is between 3 and 10^3, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^3
preconditions.description: The sum of all N values across all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^3.

postconditions.description: Each element in the array A is between 1 and 10^18, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: For all 1 <= i <= N, there exists a subsequence S of A such that gcd(S) = i
postconditions.description: For every integer i from 1 to N, there is a subsequence of A whose gcd is i.
